run_llvm_instcount_policy_evaluation: run eval_llvm_instcount_policy to evaluate an LlvmEnv policy on the cBench benchmark dataset
create_llvm_instcount_policy_function: create a policy function that takes an LlvmEnv and performs actions to maximize instruction count reduction reward
create_stateful_llvm_policy_class: create a stateful policy class with __call__ method that accepts an LlvmEnv for leaderboard evaluation
run_llvm_instcount_with_flags: run eval_llvm_instcount_policy with --n=5 --max_benchmarks=3 --resume flags to control evaluation scope
review_llvm_instcount_eval_worker: review the _EvalPolicyWorker thread class that evaluates policies and writes CompilerEnvState results to CSV
